name: schema-descriptions-roundtrip
$comment: Schema descriptions (table `description` + per-field `fieldDescriptions`, keyed by field name): pure wire metadata that every runner must accept on push — the server persists them verbatim in the stored schema JSON (admin schema read-back serves the same JSON) and old-schema clients decode the schema unchanged because both keys are optional with skip_serializing_if (a description-less table serializes WITHOUT them — pinned by core/src/schema.rs::table_descriptions_wire_contract and ts-client's schema.test.ts). Descriptions change no query result, step result, error code, or document visibility; this case pins that the described schema pushes, seeds, and queries normally.
